decisions.reason: The accent remains governed by its existing rule to derive from the Hero V geometry. Refining the Hero V's right-arm reach does not change that derivation rule or explicitly establish a new accent-specific value.

The closing V remains derived from the Hero V under its existing rule. The source refines the opening V's silhouette and right-arm termination but does not change the closing V's derivation rule or establish a closing-V-specific modification.
The source concerns only refinement of the Hero V. It neither resumes nor changes the deferred E and L letterform requirement.
The source changes geometric treatment of the Hero V and makes no decision about the deferred champagne material treatment.
The Hero V refinement does not alter the deferred requirement for cohesive full-wordmark kerning.
Preserving the Hero V's confident silhouette and extending its right arm does not change the established hierarchy in which the closing V remains smaller and subordinate.
The client's clarification of desired geometry is design feedback, not a change to the requirement that the freelancer include rationale with each design round.
